# `test_framework`

- **Type:** String: `doctest`, `googletest`, `unity`, `custom`
- **Multiple values:** No
- **Default:** `unity`

A Unit Testing framework name. See the [Testing Frameworks](../../../guides/unit-testing/frameworks/index.md) for the available frameworks.
